label: Swing structure break (50)
gloss: the swing structure's break on this bar — BOS when the close crosses its latest uncrossed level with the bias, CHoCH against it — over pivots of length 50; absent on a bar with no break — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.
